subject.title: [Feature]: Add native checkpoint engine with deterministic resume and diff

question: Should OpenClaw own a core native checkpoint/replay/diff contract, and what should the first version expose across Gateway protocol, persistence, replay safety, validation, and UI/CLI surfaces?
rationale: The request is useful but spans core protocol, persisted session state, security boundaries, replay semantics, and related issue ownership; automation cannot safely choose that product/API shape.

options.title: Define Core Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open as the native checkpoint umbrella and require a small design/API decision before implementation starts.

options.title: Move To Plugin/API Extension
options.body: If maintainers want plugin ownership, define only the missing checkpoint/context-engine extension API needed for an external plugin to implement it.

options.title: Reject Broad Native Engine
options.body: Close this direction if maintainers decide compaction branch/restore plus narrower restart/snapshot issues are the only core-supported recovery surfaces.

recommendation.title: Define Core Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the native checkpoint umbrella and require a small design/API decision before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete supplied the live product-review context on this issue and is the clearest routing candidate for the checkpoint API decision.
